courses.title: Real Analysis II
courses.description: Metric spaces, completeness, compactness, and the convergence of sequences and series of functions.

lectures.title: Metric Spaces
lectures.summary: Distance functions, open and closed balls, and the basic topology they induce.

lectures.title: Complete Metric Spaces
lectures.summary: Cauchy sequences, completeness, and why R^n is complete.

lectures.title: Uniform Convergence
lectures.summary: Pointwise vs. uniform convergence of sequences of functions and why the difference matters.

lectures.title: Series of Functions
lectures.summary: The Weierstrass M-test and term-by-term integration and differentiation.

courses.title: Complex Analysis
courses.description: Holomorphic functions, contour integration, and the beautiful rigidity of complex-differentiable maps.

lectures.title: Analytic Functions & the Cauchy–Riemann Equations
lectures.summary: Complex differentiability and the conditions that characterise it.

lectures.title: Cauchy's Integral Formula
lectures.summary: How the values of an analytic function inside a contour are determined by its values on the boundary.

courses.title: Ordinary Differential Equations II
courses.description: Series solutions, special functions, and Laplace transform techniques for solving ODEs.

lectures.title: Power Series Solutions
lectures.summary: Solving linear ODEs about an ordinary point using power series.

lectures.title: The Laplace Transform
lectures.summary: Turning differential equations into algebraic ones with the Laplace transform.

courses.title: Abstract Algebra
courses.description: Groups, rings, and the structures that make algebra 'abstract' — and powerful.

lectures.title: Groups and Subgroups
lectures.summary: The group axioms, first examples, and how to recognise a subgroup.

lectures.title: Lagrange's Theorem
lectures.summary: Why the order of a subgroup always divides the order of the group.

courses.title: Fundamentals of Topology
courses.description: Open sets, continuity, and connectedness — the language beneath modern analysis.

courses.title: Numerical Analysis II
courses.description: Numerical methods for differentiation, integration, and solving differential equations.

courses.title: Mathematical Methods
courses.description: Fourier series, boundary value problems, and techniques for applied mathematics.

courses.title: Optimization
courses.description: Linear and nonlinear optimization, convexity, and the theory of optimal solutions.

courses.title: Stochastic Calculus
courses.description: Brownian motion, stochastic integration, and Ito's formula.

courses.title: Introduction to Actuarial Mathematics
courses.description: Interest theory, annuities, and the mathematics behind insurance and pensions.

courses.title: Math Lab III (FORTRAN)
courses.description: Scientific computing and numerical programming in FORTRAN.

courses.title: Viva Voce
courses.description: Oral examination covering the full third-year syllabus.
